title: Value after the loop

pick.code:
x = 1
while x < 50:
    x = x * 3
print(x)

x = 100
while x > 10:
    x = x // 2
print(x)

s = 0
i = 1
while s < 20:
    s += i
    i += 1
print(s)

hints: Trace until the condition is False.
The last value makes it False.
solution:
The loop stops at the first value that fails the condition.

It prints `[$c.out]`.
